cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PY'
import json,subprocess,random
rng=random.Random(7)
C,E,F,K,W=8,4,8,5,16
def rb(n): return [rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(n)]
model=dict(classes=C,embedding_dim=E,length_embedding=[rb(E) for _ in range(16)],
  gap_embedding=[rb(E) for _ in range(16)],kernel=K,
  conv_weights=[[rb(2*E) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(F)],
  conv_bias=[rng.randint(-2147483648,2147483647) for _ in range(F)],
  conv_shift=[rng.randint(0,16) for _ in range(F)],
  dense_weights=[rb(F) for _ in range(C)],
  dense_bias=[rng.randint(-2147483648,2147483647) for _ in range(C)])
te=[0]+sorted(rng.sample(range(1,10**12),15))
ce=[0]+sorted(rng.sample(range(1,20001),15))
cfg=dict(slots=256,window=W,idle_timeout=10**12,len_quantum=65535,gap_quantum=65535,
  rate_num=10**6,rate_den=10**6,bucket_capacity=512,initial_tokens=512,pending_capacity=512,
  lanes=4,service=[rng.randint(1,10**6) for _ in range(C)],fallback=C-1,
  time_edges=te,count_edges=ce,
  probability=[[rng.choice([0,65536,rng.randint(0,65536)]) for _ in ce] for _ in te])
conns=[dict(id="A"*32,slot=255,label=7,split="eval"),dict(id="z",slot=0,label=0,split="dev")]
packets=[dict(time=i*7,connection="A"*32,length=rng.randint(0,65535),draw=rng.randint(0,65535)) for i in range(30)]
packets+= [dict(time=1000+i,connection="z",length=i,draw=0) for i in range(10)]
packets.sort(key=lambda p:p['time'])
doc=dict(version=1,config=cfg,model=model,connections=conns,packets=packets)
p=subprocess.run(['python3','submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print("rc",p.returncode,"outlen",len(p.stdout),"head",p.stdout[:40])
o=json.loads(p.stdout); print("keys",list(o.keys()) if 'error' not in o else o)
